steps.label: Open on its own
steps.detail: Check the plug-in window outside your DAW. This does not test audio in your DAW.

steps.label: Check the display
steps.detail: Check how the plug-in window works with the current display settings.

steps.label: Try another display mode
steps.detail: Prepare different display settings, then choose whether to apply them. Your previous settings are kept.

steps.label: Restore accessibility defaults
steps.detail: Prepare this plug-in's default Windows accessibility settings for its next launch. Applying them is a separate step.

steps.label: Continue installation repair
steps.detail: Continue an unfinished installation for this setup. Restoring display settings will not undo installation changes.

steps.label: Restore the previous settings
steps.detail: Return to the settings used before this trial. This does not undo installation changes.

steps.label: Record what happened
steps.detail: Describe what happened with the settings you tested.
